bindingRow: The two verdicts opensTheSameBlock (src/print/reflow.ts) now compares: what the reader makes of the block's own first source line, and what it makes of the line the packer would write there. This type carried a DECLARED reading with the one parameter a re-read could lose, the marker style; the style is read off the source line's own verdict instead (readsTheSameOpening, src/line-verdict.ts), which is the same fact from the place that already holds it. NARROWER: the declared reading was only ever built as `text`, so the question was asked at the document-paragraph site alone, and the comparison asks it at every site the packer writes a first line.
mutant: readsTheSameOpening (src/line-verdict.ts) returns true for every pair of verdicts, so no first output line is ever refused. Measured: 5 test files and 28 tests red, tests/format/packed-line-reading.test.ts among them.
